svg.title: The block: one highway, two deposits
svg.desc: A hand-drawn whiteboard showing a thick vertical residual stream labelled (B, T, 4096) with two side branches rejoining it through plus symbols - a narrow attention branch of 41.9 million parameters preceded by an RMSNorm, and a much wider feed-forward branch of gate, up and down projections between 4096 and 14336 totalling 176.2 million - with a crossed-out post-norm alternative at the left, two bars showing the feed-forward network is 81 percent of every layer, and the running arithmetic 218.1M times 32 plus two 525M embedding tables reaching 8.03 billion parameters.
svg.text: The block: one highway, two deposits
